subject: Satellite demo hub + partner cohort plan (Summit week)
messages:
From: Maya Collins <maya@veridiansys.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Partnership Ops <partners@veridiansys.com>, ravi.shah@veridiansys.com
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Satellite demo hub idea for Summit week — quick ask

Hi Olga,

Really enjoyed the product briefing last week — Veridian is excited about the demo flow you showed. We have a slot during Summit week to run a "satellite demo hub" adjacent to the main booth: a smaller, staffed area where customers can see deeper inference demos and book 1:1 follow-ups.

High-level ask from our side: would Redwood co-staff the hub for two mornings (Wed/Thu), and provide an MDF contribution toward sample hardware rental and snack station? We typically split costs 50/50 and cover one speaker slot in exchange for brand presence in the program.

Proposed quick next steps:
- Confirm Redwood headcount for hub (2-3 people each morning)
- Agree MDF amount and SOW outline
- Lock speaker slot and coordinate agenda items

I attached a simple floor sketch and rough cost estimate. Can you loop in whoever owns MDF approvals?

Thanks — Maya
Maya Collins
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Veridian Systems
Attachment: satellite-floorplan.png (PNG), cost-estimate.xlsx (referenced)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Maya Collins <maya@veridiansys.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Satellite demo hub idea for Summit week — quick ask

Maya — really appreciate the clear proposal and the sketch. This aligns well with our Q2 activation goals. Quick answers up front: yes on co-staffing two mornings, and we can commit to a shared speaker slot.

Aditya — I am looping you for MDF/finance approval and a proposed SOW.
Tessa — ops — can you confirm if we can spare 3 reps per morning and whether the demo kit checklist below looks right?

Demo kit checklist (draft):
- 2x RTX-class laptops with NVLink passthrough
- Local wifi + backup hotspot
- HDMI switch + spare adaptors
- Printed one-pagers and lead capture tablet

Maya — can you send a target MDF number? We usually ask partners to propose the SOW and Redwood will redline.

Thanks — O
Olga Petrov
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, Maya Collins <maya@veridiansys.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Satellite demo hub idea for Summit week — quick ask

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the sketch and cost notes. We can cover up to $8,500 in MDF for shared expenses (hardware rental + on-site services) provided we get a signed SOW and a simple success metric: 40 qualified leads (MQL) attributed to the hub over the week and a post-event recording.

I'll attach a first-pass SOW template for you to adapt — it includes payment milestones (50% on signing, 50% 15 days after event) and a clause about brand co-placement. I also added a clause to allow Redwood to route overflow demo requests to our hosted trial.

Attachment: VERIDIAN_Redwood_MDF_SOW_v1.pdf

If that looks OK, can Veridian send the updated SOW by EOD Thursday so we can route to legal?

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Maya Collins <maya@veridiansys.com>, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 9 Apr 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Satellite demo hub idea for Summit week — quick ask

All — ops notes and a lightweight schedule so we can finalize staffing. I moved the summit-week agenda draft into Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bExAMPLElink and attached the agenda here for quick reference.

Proposed staffing cadence (per morning):
- 07:30 — 09:30: 1 lead demo engineer + 1 solutions AE at the hub (high-touch)
- 09:30 — 11:30: 2 solutions AEs (walk-by demos + lead capture)
- 11:30 — 13:00: 1 closer on rotation for booked 1:1s

Ops asks for Veridian:
- Confirm on-site contact and local power access point on the floorplan
- Provide logo assets for co-branding (PNG/SVG) by next Tue

Attachments: summit-week-agenda-draft.docx

Happy to own the inventory checklist and a small shipping label for demo kits. I'll also create a shared calendar group so staffing slots are visible.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Events Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@veridiansys.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Maya Collins <maya@veridiansys.com>, Partnership Ops <partners@veridiansys.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Apr 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Satellite demo hub idea for Summit week — quick ask

Olga / Team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the SOW draft. We reviewed internally and can accept the $8,500 MDF with the 40 MQL metric. We'll populate your SOW with our billing info and brand assets and upload to the Drive link by Monday COB.

One note — can we add a half-hour joint "deep dive" slot on Wednesday at 14:00 where a Veridian engineer and Redwood solutions lead walk through an end-to-end inference case study? We'll promote that in our invite list.

I'll also loop our procurement contact for contracts.

Best,
Ravi
Ravi Shah
Director, Strategic Accounts
Veridian Systems
